description_en: Queries the compliance results of resources in a compliance package
description_zh: 查询合规包中资源的合规结果
name: GetResourceComplianceByPack

parameters.help_en:
The compliance package ID.

For information about how to obtain the compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

ResourceComplianceResult.description_en: The compliance results of resources in the compliance package
ResourceComplianceResult.description_zh: 合规包中资源的合规结果

CompliantCount.description_en:
The total number of resources with an evaluation result of "Compliant" when the rules in the compliance package evaluate resources.

Note: If the same resource is evaluated as compliant by different rules in the compliance package, for example, evaluated as compliant by two rules simultaneously, the count is incremented by 2
CompliantCount.description_zh:
合规包内的规则评估资源时，评估结果为“合规”的资源总数。

注意，若同一个资源被合规包下不同规则评估为合规，如同时被两个规则评估为合规，这里的数目+2

IgnoredCount.description_en: The total number of resources for which evaluation results have been set to ignored when the rules in the compliance package evaluate resources
IgnoredCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则评估资源时，已经设置忽略评估结果的资源总数

InsufficientDataCount.description_en: The total number of resources with an evaluation result of "Insufficient Data" when the rules in the compliance package evaluate resources
InsufficientDataCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则评估资源时，评估结果为“无数据”的资源总数

NotApplicableCount.description_en:
The total number of resources with an evaluation result of "Not Applicable" when the rules in the compliance package evaluate resources.

Note: If the same resource is evaluated as "Not Applicable" by different rules in the compliance package, for example, evaluated as "Not Applicable" by two rules simultaneously, the count is incremented by 2
NotApplicableCount.description_zh:
合规包内的规则评估资源时，评估结果为“不适用”的资源总数。

注意，若同一个资源被合规包下不同规则评估为“不适用”，如同时被两个规则评估为“不适用”，这里的数目+2
